definition: נִיסָן proper name of 1st month (loan-word from Babylonian Nisannu , compare Schr COT Neh 1 . 1 Muss-Arn JBL xi. 1 (1892). 76 ; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; so Nabataean, Palmyrene, see Lzb 323 ); — only post-exile: ׳ חֹדֶשׁ נ Neh 2:1 ; Esth 3:7 ( + הָרִאשׁוֺן הַחֹדֶשׁ ), = pre-exile הָאָבִּיב ( הֹדֶשׁ ). — On sacredness of Nisan compare also RS Semitic i. 387; 2d ed. 406 f . נִיצוֺץ see נצץ . נֵיר see נֵר .

נִיסָן proper name of 1st month (loan-word from Babylonian Nisannu, compare SchrCOT Neh 1. 1 Muss-ArnJBL xi. 1 (1892). 76; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; so Nabataean, Palmyrene, see Lzb323); — only post-exile: ׳חֹדֶשׁ נ Neh 2:1; Esth 3:7 ( + הָרִאשׁוֺן הַחֹדֶשׁ), = pre-exile הָאָבִּיב (הֹדֶשׁ). — On sacredness of Nisan compare also RSSemitic i. 387; 2d ed. 406 f.

נִיצוֺץ see נצץ. נֵיר see נֵר.
